verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted chat interface, so a training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of any such control or guarantee. Self-hosting is an adjacent deployment feature, not a training control: prompts still go to third-party model providers. The community note that OpenAI does not train on API usage describes the provider's policy, not a LibreChat capability, and routing to local models through a LiteLLM proxy is a user workaround. Neither earns credit under the partial-credit rules.
